tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground (first stop of the body gradient). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: color-yellow
tokens.usage: Energy, optimism, attention (coins, rewards). Used as text on `.card-stars`. 1.2:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-pink
tokens.usage: Playfulness, warmth, excitement (highlights, CTAs). Used as background on `.badge-streak`. 2.3:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-pink-light
tokens.usage: Declared in the style's palette. 1.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-purple
tokens.usage: Premium, magic, special items (rare achievements). Used as text on `nav a:hover, nav a:focus`. 3.3:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-orange
tokens.usage: Achievement, enthusiasm, action (buttons, progress). Used as background on `.badge-bronze`, `.badge-streak`.

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: Clarity, cleanliness, modern feel. Used as text on `header h1`, `nav a`, `.card-badge`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: stat-progress-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.stat-progress`, `.badge-silver`; border on `.card-footer`, `.table-filter`, `.form-input, .form-select, .form-textarea`.

tokens.name: tbody-td-border
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: border on `tbody td`, `tbody td:first-child`, `tbody td:last-child`.
